prompt: Create a production-ready 2D aquarium game sprite PNG with a TRUE TRANSPARENT RGBA alpha background. Exactly ONE fish only. Input images are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY: match their glossy bright shaded cartoon game rendering, crisp dark outline and friendly expressive eye, but do not copy their species or anatomy. Single isolated complete whole-body fish in LEFT-FACING SIDE PROFILE, nose left, tail right, centered on landscape canvas with 5% transparent padding. Body and all fins fully uncropped. No text, no bubbles, no props, no ground shadow, no environment, no gradients outside the fish. Empty pixels must be transparent (alpha zero), not a checkerboard or a white background. Detailed species markings must remain legible at mobile thumbnail size. Species: Zebra Danio (Danio rerio), a slim torpedo-shaped silver-gold freshwater fish with FIVE striking continuous navy-blue HORIZONTAL longitudinal stripes from gill to the base of the forked tail, with striped dorsal and tail fins. Small clear amber fins, slender body, slightly upturned mouth and large friendly eye. Do not make it deep-bodied or vertically striped. Its defining feature is strong blue horizontal stripes.
